Goalie_GAA.definition: Matched confirmed goalie actual all-strength goals allowed per60 minutes.
Goalie_GAA.guard: current-season confirmed/official named match,GP>0; no10-game minimum
Goalie_GAA.label: Opposing goalie GAA
Goalie_GAA.tooltip: Actual goals allowed per60 goalie minutes. Uses the matched goalie record, not the teams overall goals allowed.

Goalie_SV.definition: Matched confirmed goalie all-strength save percentage.
Goalie_SV.guard: current-season confirmed/official named match,GP>0; no10-game minimum
Goalie_SV.label: Opposing goalie save percentage
Goalie_SV.tooltip: Share of shots stopped in the matched current-season record. .900 means90%. Requires a named confirmed or official starter and matching stats.

Official_Opp_PK_L10_Goals_PG.definition: Strictly-prior official Opp PK_L10_Goals_PG; complete5/10-game windows or actual prior season/venue denominator. PPP credits are goals plus skater assists, not team goals.
Official_Opp_PK_L10_Goals_PG.label: Opponent recent PP goals allowed
Official_Opp_PK_L10_Goals_PG.tooltip: Power-play goals conceded across10 previous games divided by10. A1.10 average means11 PP goals allowed over those10 games.

Official_Opp_PK_L10_Seconds_per_O.definition: Strictly-prior official Opp PK_L10_Seconds_per_O; complete5/10-game windows or actual prior season/venue denominator. PPP credits are goals plus skater assists, not team goals.
Official_Opp_PK_L10_Seconds_per_O.label: Opponent PK time per opportunity
Official_Opp_PK_L10_Seconds_per_O.tooltip: Total shorthanded seconds divided by times shorthanded over10 prior games. A PP goal can end a penalty, so shorter duration is not the same as fewer penalties.

Official_Opp_PK_L5_PPP_per_O.definition: Strictly-prior official Opp PK_L5_PPP_per_O; complete5/10-game windows or actual prior season/venue denominator. PPP credits are goals plus skater assists, not team goals.
Official_Opp_PK_L5_PPP_per_O.label: Opponent recent PP damage
Official_Opp_PK_L5_PPP_per_O.tooltip: Skater power-play points allowed divided by times shorthanded over five prior games. One PP goal can credit a goal and two assists, so1.10 does not mean110% team scoring chance.

PPP_Line.source: strict-prior2026-27 Form_Log or unchanged frozen savedmodel;no imputation
PPP_Line.label: Power-play point line
PPP_Line.tooltip: Over0.5 requires at least one power-play goal or assist. Read the exact offered line from the quote.

PP_OnIce_xG_per_game.source: strict-prior2026-27 Form_Log or unchanged frozen savedmodel;no imputation
PP_OnIce_xG_per_game.label: PP on-ice expected goals/game
PP_OnIce_xG_per_game.tooltip: Expected goals for the team while this player is on power-play ice, per game. Includes teammates chances; not individual player xG.

Player_L10_P_per60.source: strict-prior2026-27 Form_Log or unchanged frozen savedmodel;no imputation
Player_L10_P_per60.label: Recent point pace
Player_L10_P_per60.tooltip: Goals plus assists per60 minutes of total player ice time across up to10 previous games. Higher means more points for the ice time played.

Player_L20_P_1plus_pct.source: strict-prior2026-27 Form_Log or unchanged frozen savedmodel;no imputation
Player_L20_P_1plus_pct.label: Recent point hit rate
Player_L20_P_1plus_pct.tooltip: Share of up to20 previous games with at least one goal or assist. Show games available; no20-game minimum is added.

Player_L20_P_total.source: strict-prior2026-27 Form_Log or unchanged frozen savedmodel;no imputation
Player_L20_P_total.label: Recent total points
Player_L20_P_total.tooltip: Goals plus assists in up to20 previous games. This is a count, so players with more games have had more chances to accumulate points.

Player_L5_A_per60.source: strict-prior2026-27 Form_Log or unchanged frozen savedmodel;no imputation
Player_L5_A_per60.label: Recent assist pace
Player_L5_A_per60.tooltip: Actual assists per60 minutes of total player ice time across up to5 previous games.

Points_mu.source: strict-prior2026-27 Form_Log or unchanged frozen savedmodel;no imputation
Points_mu.label: Saved points projection
Points_mu.tooltip: The existing models saved mean for total points. A broader production signal, not a power-play hit probability.

i5v5_primaryAssists60.source: strict-prior2026-27 Form_Log or unchanged frozen savedmodel;no imputation
i5v5_primaryAssists60.label: Primary assists at5v5
i5v5_primaryAssists60.tooltip: Recorded first assists per60 minutes at5v5. A first assist is the last credited pass before the goal. This is not expected assists.

opp_5v5_xGA60.definition: Unchanged saved current-season Opponent 5v5 expected goals allowed/60; original frozen slate values.
opp_5v5_xGA60.label: Opponent5v5 chances allowed
opp_5v5_xGA60.tooltip: Expected goals allowed per60 minutes at5v5. Tested here as PPP matchup context; this is not a penalty-kill rate.
